issues.detail: Assertion 0 is complete:true on CompletionPolicy/CycleMode/Request, so a run that does nothing at all would also pass it. This matches the assertion text (the policy is preserved) and assertion 1 plus the judge cover the routing, so it does not mis-test the case.

The guide says any value other than a positive integer for PORT/RETRY_LIMIT stops the relay; an empty string actually falls back to the default (env.X ? ... : default). This wording predates the cycle for PORT and is immaterial to AC-002, so it is not a planted defect a Documenter must catch.
